purpose: Teach: 電卓/めまい/日課/美徳/二次会/失恋/老婆/バルト

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、数学の宿題で、本気で、絶対、電卓、絶対、使ってもいいんだよね
lines.en: Riku — you can use a calculator on the math homework, right? Like, seriously?
lines.style: Bright, almost teasing opening. Quick rhythm. Leans into the question mark like she already knows the answer and wants confirmation. Playful.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。最近、本気で、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、めまい、絶対、するんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Lately I've actually been getting a little dizzy from it, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, self-deprecating delivery. Slight smile in the voice — admitting something absurd without drama. Steady pace, casual rhythm of real conversation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、毎朝のランニング、絶対、日課、絶対、続けてるんだよね、リク
lines.en: You're seriously keeping up with those morning runs every day, aren't you, Riku?
lines.style: Approving warmth underneath. Not overly enthusiastic — just noticing what he does and respecting it. Slight lift at the end, checking if she's right. Genuine.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活で、本気で、絶対、礼儀正しさは、絶対、美徳、絶対、だぜ、桜
lines.en: In the club, politeness is seriously a virtue, Sakura.
lines.style: Firm but not preachy. Matter-of-fact conviction — like he's thought about this. Steady delivery, grounded. Not defensive, just clear.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 卒業式の後、本気で、絶対、二次会、絶対、お前と、絶対、行きたいよ、リク
lines.en: After graduation, I really want to go to the after-party with you, Riku.
lines.style: Earnest underneath the casual phrasing. Slight acceleration as she gets to the main point. Vulnerable — she's saying something that matters. Small trailing hesitation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、失恋、絶対、したら、絶対、俺、絶対、相談乗るぜ、桜
lines.en: If you ever get heartbroken, I'll listen, Sakura. I mean it.
lines.style: Quiet, serious commitment. No performance — just a statement of fact about what he'll do. Warm but not soft. Direct eye-contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんちの近所の、本気で、絶対、老婆、絶対、優しい人なんだよ、リク
lines.en: The old woman who lives near my grandmother's place — she's really kind, Riku.
lines.style: Thoughtful, gentle reflection. Slower pace. Soft affection for the memory of her. Not dramatic — just genuine noticing of someone small and good.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 地理の授業で、本気で、絶対、バルト、絶対、三国、絶対、習ったよな、桜
lines.en: We learned about the Baltic states in geography, remember, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet, searching. Like he's reaching back for a shared memory. Gentle question mark at the end. Thoughtful rather than eager.
